name: The Protagonist
description: Murdered by betrayal, refusing to enter eternal slumber until vengeance is fulfilled.

name: The Butcher
description: A brutal syndicate enforcer who slaughtered anyone who questioned the syndicate boss.

name: The Strategist
description: The calculating schemer who orchestrated the traps and setup that led to your demise.

name: The Pale Apparition
description: A restless specter bound to the underworld who whispers clues of the resurrection loophole.

name: The Betrayer
description: Your closest friend who sold your life for passage out of the city.
